notBuilt.body: This page is part of MASAR and arrives in a later delivery phase.

notFound.body: There is no page at this address.

signIn.strap: Every person and every cargo moving offshore, on one system.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Use your ADNOC email address. You will be taken to ADNOC single sign-on.
signIn.note: Access is granted through ADNOC identity. Accounts are not created here.
signIn.externalLink: Contractors and service providers without an ADNOC account sign in through a separate external access route.

errors.DEACTIVATED: Access is granted through ADNOC identity. Accounts are not created here.
errors.NO_ROLE: Access is granted through ADNOC identity. Accounts are not created here.

errors.EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT: This account signs in through the external access route, with email and password.

external.title: External access
external.lead: For contractors and service providers without an ADNOC account.
external.codeLead: We emailed a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
external.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
external.resetLead: Enter your email. If it belongs to an external account, we will email a reset link.
external.resetSent: If an external account uses that address, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for 1 hour.

setPassword.lead: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
setPassword.codeLead: We emailed a 6-digit code to confirm the reset.
setPassword.done: Your password is set. Sign in with it and the code we email you.
setPassword.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.

account.changed: Your password is changed. Your other sessions have ended.
account.title: My account
account.subtitle: Who MASAR knows you as, what you may do, and where you are signed in.
account.profileHint: These details come from your source system and can only be changed there.
account.devicesHint: The phones and tablets where the MASAR App is signed in as you.
account.noDevices: The MASAR App isn’t signed in anywhere.
account.revokeDeviceBody: The app on it signs out and wipes its data. Signing in again there registers it afresh.
account.preferencesHint: Mandatory categories can’t be turned off.
account.passwordHint: You sign in with your email, password and an emailed code.

confirm.reasonHint: A reason is required and is recorded in the audit log.

dropzone.wrongType: {{name}} is not an accepted file type.

audit.loadFailed: The history could not be loaded. Try again.

masters.deactivateBody: It stays on record but can no longer be chosen. You can reactivate it later.
masters.reactivateBody: It can be chosen again from now on.
masters.deleteBody: It leaves every list. The record and its history are kept for audit.
masters.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded. Try again.
masters.exportFailed: The export could not be downloaded. Try again.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: The directory of everyone who can sign in — how each person signs in, which role and scope they hold, when their access expires and any delegation in place. Users are not created by hand: they arrive from source systems.

filters.search: Search by name, email or personnel no.

drawer.self: This is you. Another administrator changes your access (segregation of duties).
drawer.left: {{source}} reports that this person has left. They can be reactivated once they are active there again.
drawer.noRoles: No roles yet. Until a role is assigned this person can't sign in.

dialog.referenceHint: The request this change answers, e.g. RITM0012345. It is recorded in the audit log.
dialog.deactivateBody: They are signed out everywhere, their app devices and delegations end, and they can't sign in. Their roles are kept for when they are reactivated.
dialog.reactivateBody: They can sign in again with the roles they still hold.
dialog.revokeBody: {{name}} loses this role on their next request.
dialog.inviteBody: They get an email with a link, valid for 7 days, to set their password. An earlier link stops working.
dialog.tierBody: When several people could approve, the lowest tier is asked first.

assignment.lineManagerOf: The people who report to them

levelHint.site: Set by site: choose locations, or whole zones.
levelHint.self: Covers the person's own records, or their reports.

assignment.untilHint: Leave “Access until” empty for access with no expiry.
assignment.adminTier: Admin tier: only a Super Admin can give, change or take away this role.

analytics.activeUsersSub: Signed in during the last 30 days
analytics.expiring: Access ending in the next 30 days
analytics.expiringNone: No access ends in the next 30 days.

contacts.title: External Organisation Contacts
contacts.subtitle: People of service providers that aren’t in Fieldglass. Activating a contact gives them a MASAR sign-in: they get an email to set their password.
contacts.search: Search by name, email or personnel no.
contacts.activateBody: An external user is created and emailed a link to set their password. Assign them roles on the Users page.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: What each role is for, who holds it and how many may.
roles.banner: A role decides nothing on its own — what it may open and do is set on the Access Rights Matrix.
roles.search: Search by name, code or purpose

form.codeHint: Permanent: the name can change later, the code can’t.
form.codeHintNew: Leave empty to make it from the name. Permanent once saved.
form.name: Name
form.maxHoldersInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100,000, or leave it empty
form.codeInvalid: Use 3–41 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens
form.descriptionRequired: Say what the role is for

matrix.title: Access Rights Matrix
matrix.subtitle: What each role holds — module by module, and page by page within it.
matrix.rules: Any right brings View. Delete and Reopen are for admin-tier roles only. A module switched off removes every page in it. Changes apply on everyone’s next request, and every save is a new version.

readOnly.super-admin: Super Admin holds every right; its matrix is fixed.
readOnly.own-role: You hold this role, so you can’t change its rights. Ask another administrator.
readOnly.locked: This role is locked: only a Super Admin can change it.
readOnly.view-only: You can look at the matrix but not change it.

capability.everywhere: Wherever the holder’s own scope reaches

matrix.conflict: Someone saved the matrix after you opened it. Reload to see their changes, then make yours again.

delegation.searchPeople: Search by name, email or personnel no.
delegation.periodRequired: Choose when it starts and ends

delegations.title: Delegation
delegations.subtitle: Who acts for whom, on which workflows, and until when. Every action is recorded “by the delegate on behalf of the delegator”.
delegations.revokeBody: The delegate stops acting for the delegator at once.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Phones and tablets where the MASAR App is signed in. A device you revoke here stays blocked until you lift the block.
devices.search: Search by person, email, model or device id
devices.blockBody: The app on it signs out and wipes its data, and nobody can sign in on it until the block is lifted.
devices.unblockBody: Its owner can sign in on it again, which registers it afresh.

notificationsPage.title: Notifications
notificationsPage.subtitle: Alerts in MASAR and the emails it sent you.

approvals.title: Approval Engine
approvals.subtitle: One engine; each module owns its approval chains.
approvals.search: Search by workflow name or code
approvals.banner: The most specific active workflow that matches a request takes it. A workflow without conditions is the process’s fallback. A changed chain becomes a new version; requests already started keep theirs.

conditions.none: This process has no conditions to set.
conditions.valuesHint: Separate values with commas. Empty: any.

amount.order: The lower limit is above the upper one

form.versionNote: Saving a changed chain creates a new version. Requests already started stay on theirs.
form.name: Name
form.codeHint: Permanent: the name can change later, the code can’t.
form.conditionsHint: A request must meet every condition you set. Set none to make this the process’s fallback.
form.stagesHint: Each stage waits for the one before. Nobody approves a request they raised or that was raised for them.
form.reminderHint: Empty: no reminders. Approvers after the first tier are told at half the SLA.
form.skip: Skip this stage when the request meets conditions
form.skipHint: Stages are skipped only by their conditions, never by hand.
form.requests: Requests that have used this workflow: {{count}}
form.codeInvalid: Use 3–61 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter
form.processRequired: Choose the process this workflow is for
form.reminderInvalid: Enter whole hours from 1 to 720, or leave empty

rules.title: Business Rules
rules.subtitle: Typed rules the modules apply: cut-offs, certificates, limits and bands.
rules.search: Search by rule name, code or type
rules.banner: Each rule has a type, a condition, typed parameters and a priority (1 first). A change is a new version from its start; high-impact rules change only once a Super Admin approves.
rules.missing: No rule in force for: {{types}}. Actions that need them are refused until one is set.

end.title: End {{name}}?
end.body: The rule stops applying now. It stays in the history and can be reinstated.
end.bodyApproval: This is a high-impact rule: a Super Admin must approve the end, and it stays in effect until then.

reinstate.title: Reinstate {{name}}?
reinstate.body: The rule applies again from now, with its last values.
reinstate.bodyApproval: This is a high-impact rule: it applies again once a Super Admin approves.

pending.title: Version {{n}} awaits approval
pending.yours: You can decide it. Approved, it takes effect from its start.
pending.waiting: A Super Admin decides it. The rule can’t change until then.

form.name: Name
form.codeHint: Permanent: the name can change later, the code can’t.
form.highImpact: High impact: this rule changes only once a Super Admin approves (ADR-0043).
form.conditionHint: The rule applies when the case meets every condition you set. Set none to apply to every case.
form.priorityHint: 1 is the highest; it decides when several rules apply.
form.startsHint: Otherwise at once. Never in the past.
form.startsHintApproval: Otherwise once approved. Never in the past.
form.codeInvalid: Use 3–61 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter
form.priorityInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 999
form.momentRequired: Enter a date and a time

engine.title: Notification Engine
engine.subtitle: Who hears of what, how and how often: rules on the modules' events.
engine.search: Search by rule name, code or trigger
engine.banner: A rule fires on an event, filtered on what the event says, and reaches its recipients with a template per channel. Rules on events from later phases wait until their module publishes them.

log.title: Delivery log
log.search: Search by recipient, address or subject

form.name: Name
form.codeHint: Permanent: the name can change later, the code can’t.
form.waits: This trigger’s event is published from phase {{phase}}; the rule waits until then.
form.mandatory: A mandatory category: people can’t opt out, and only a Super Admin can switch the rule off.
form.filterHint: The rule fires only for events that meet every condition you set. Set none for every event.
form.peopleHint: Who the event names, or who is found from it.
form.rolesHint: Their holders; where the event has a location, those whose scope reaches it.
form.emailsHint: Separate with commas. Only a Super Admin can set them.
form.codeInvalid: Use 3–61 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter

reasons.title: Reason Codes
reasons.subtitle: One central list behind every reason dropdown in the platform.

contexts.confirmBody: Every page that asks for this reason follows at once.

form.commentRequired: A comment is required with this reason
form.codeInvalid: Use letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. DLY-WX
form.orderInvalid: Enter a whole number up to 9999

requests.newBody: Those who maintain reason codes are told, and decide.
requests.declineBody: The requester is told, with your reason.

auditLog.title: Audit Log
auditLog.subtitle: Who did what, when, from where, and what changed.
auditLog.search: Search actions, records, people or reference IDs
auditLog.loadFailed: The audit log could not be loaded. Try again.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: How long MASAR keeps its data. Set by configuration; shown here read-only.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Who to contact, and how the system behaves.
support.loadFailed: The support page could not be loaded. Try again.

technical.title: Technical support
technical.body: For sign-in problems, errors or anything not working as it should, raise a ticket with IT.
technical.noPortal: Ask your administrator how to raise a ticket.

contacts.title: Operational contacts
contacts.body: Each location's focal point, for questions about travel, stays and site operations.

articles.title: Support Articles
articles.subtitle: The questions and guides on the Support page.
articles.search: Search by title, code or text

form.bodyHint: Markdown: ## headings, **bold**, *italics*, - lists, 1. steps, [links](https://…). HTML shows as text.
form.codeInvalid: Use 3–61 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter
form.orderInvalid: Enter a whole number up to 9999

zones.title: Zones
zones.subtitle: The operating areas that scope access and approvals. Only administrators change them; the demo’s zones stand until the BRD’s Zone 1–5 mapping is agreed (P-19).

locationTypes.title: Location Types
locationTypes.subtitle: What kind of place a location is. A mobile type’s positions can change, which calls for an aerial survey; offshore types count for POB.

installationTypes.title: Installation Types
installationTypes.subtitle: Heliport or helideck, helipad, boat landing and the rest. Each is linked to its inspection checklist when helideck inspections arrive.

form.codeHint: Letters, digits and hyphens. It can’t be changed later.
form.name: Name

coordinates.hint: Decimal degrees, e.g. 25.158 and 52.872. “Get coordinates from GIS” takes them from GIS instead.
coordinates.reasonHint: Coordinates already set are overridden only with a reason.
coordinates.reasonRequired: Give a reason for changing the coordinates
coordinates.invalid: Enter both latitude (−90 to 90) and longitude (−180 to 180), or neither

service.outLocation: Its future journeys are cancelled with your reason, and the Aviation Team is told. When it returns to service, the journeys without bookings come back.
service.outInstallation: It can’t be used for flights until it is returned to service.
service.back: It can be used again from now on.
service.reasonRequired: Say why, in at least 3 characters
service.checking: Looking for the journeys it affects…
service.bookedStay: {{count}} with bookings stay cancelled when it returns, for their passengers to be moved.

locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: Sites, islands, hubs and fields, with their sub-locations, coordinates, POB limit and focal point. Taking one out of service cancels its journeys and bookings.

form.name: Name
form.residencyReset: Residency-reset location: arriving here starts a new residency period

installations.title: Installations
installations.subtitle: Helidecks, helipads and landings, with the technical data inspections use. Activation needs D, T, GCAA class of use, elevation and coordinates.
installations.search: Search by code, name or callsign
installations.activateBody: It can then be used for flights, inspections and the helideck limitations list.
installations.reactivateBody: It can be used again. The reason is recorded in its history.
installations.removeBody: It leaves the installation; the file and its history are kept for audit.

form.validityNote: Acceptance and test validity come from helideck inspections: not recorded yet.
form.name: Name
form.heading: Heading
form.confirmHint: Values entered by hand or confirmed here stop showing as pending.
form.reasonHint: Every change to an installation is kept with its reason.
form.reasonRequired: Give a reason, in at least 3 characters

routes.title: Routes
routes.subtitle: Origins, stops and destinations, with great-circle distances. Changing a route’s stops makes a new revision; schedules keep the one they were planned on.
routes.search: Search by code, place or team

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Leave blank to name it from its stops.
form.pointRequired: Choose every location on the path
form.durationInvalid: Minutes, as a whole number above zero

categories.title: Resource Categories
categories.subtitle: The top-level classes of transport resource: the parent of resource types, the mode filter in dispatch dashboards and reports, and a condition in business rules.

cargoTypes.title: Cargo Types
cargoTypes.subtitle: What freight can be booked as, and the dangerous-goods class it brings with it by default.

fuelStations.title: Fuel Stations
fuelStations.subtitle: Where aviation fuel is held, with each station’s capacity and the level at which to reorder.

fields.dgClassHint: A UN class such as 3 or 2.1; blank for ordinary cargo.
fields.dgClassInvalid: A UN class such as 3 or 2.1

types.title: Resource Types
types.subtitle: Aircraft and vessel types: capacity, seat-map template, baggage allowance and payload. Recurring schedules may use a type before a tail is assigned.

form.name: Name
form.numberInvalid: Enter a whole number of zero or more
form.seatMapHint: Rows × seats per row, with the aisle after seat n of each row. Leave blank for none.

models.title: Aircraft Models
models.subtitle: The helideck D-value and T-value each model needs; compatibility with each installation is derived from them. A model without values is “not recorded”, which flags rather than permits.

form.name: Name
form.numberInvalid: Enter a whole number of zero or more
form.confirmHint: Values entered or confirmed here stop showing as pending.
form.reasonHint: Required D and T are safety data: every change is kept with its reason.
form.reasonRequired: Give a reason, in at least 3 characters

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.subtitle: Each aircraft, helicopter and vessel, of a resource type and a service provider. Its category, seat map, baggage, payload and helideck needs come from the type; only its seat capacity can be its own. Seat quotas are set in Quotas.
fleet.search: Search by registration, type or provider
fleet.certification: Certification status comes from the aviation registers when they are built: not recorded yet.

form.registrationInvalid: 2–40 letters, digits, spaces, dots or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit
form.availabilityHint: Only available, bookable units are offered for new journeys. Journeys that already have a unit keep it.

becomes.maintenance: Under maintenance: the unit is no longer offered for new journeys.
becomes.retired: Retired: the unit is never offered for new journeys again and can’t be bookable.

form.capacityHint: Leave blank to use the type’s seat capacity. Otherwise enter 1 to {{max}}, and no more than the type’s seat map holds.
form.capacityAboveMap: The type’s seat map has {{seats}} seats; enter no more than that.
form.fromTypeHint: From the resource type; change these on Resource Types.
form.typeChanged: The seat layout, payload, baggage and helideck needs will be the new type’s once you save.
form.optionsFailed: The categories, types and providers couldn’t be loaded. Close the form and try again.
form.capacityInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}

helideck.title: Helideck compatibility
helideck.hint: From the type’s aircraft model, kept on Aircraft Models. Scheduling checks it against each helideck’s D-value and T-value.
helideck.noModel: The type has no aircraft model, so helideck compatibility is not recorded. Set one on Resource Types.

quotas.title: Quotas
quotas.subtitle: Seats held for a department, location, zone, provider or passenger category on a resource type or route, per flight, day, week or month.
quotas.notice: Quotas apply to fixed-wing services only.

form.name: Name
form.numberInvalid: Enter a whole number of zero or more

providers.title: Service Providers
providers.subtitle: Aviation, marine and test providers. The code is the prefix on every flight and voyage number the operator runs, so it can’t change. External users see only their own organisation.
providers.search: Search by code or legal name

form.codeHint: Two or three letters: the prefix on its flight and voyage numbers.
form.name: Legal name

categories.title: Passenger Categories
categories.subtitle: Who is seated first when demand exceeds capacity: lower numbers rank higher. Crew changes go first, then VIP, then the rest by rank.

form.name: Name
form.rankHint: Lower numbers are seated first; one active category per rank.
form.mappingHint: Which SAP or Fieldglass attribute maps a person here.

chargeCodes.title: Charge Codes
chargeCodes.subtitle: What travel is charged to: at every site or some, recoverable or not, with validity dates and an owning department.

form.sitesRequired: Choose at least one site, or every site
form.validityInvalid: Valid to is before valid from

departments.title: Departments
departments.subtitle: SAP’s departments are synced and read-only here; others are kept in MASAR.

companies.title: Companies
companies.subtitle: SAP’s and Fieldglass’s companies are synced and read-only here; providers’ external organisations are kept in MASAR.

notice.makerChecker: Changes here take effect only once a second person approves them. Taking a point or craft out of use is immediate.
notice.sent: Sent for a second person’s approval as {{refs}}. It applies once approved.

pob.returnBody: A second person approves this before it applies. Say why it can be used again.

form.approvalHint: This goes to a second person for approval; nothing changes until they approve it.

muster.title: Muster Points
muster.subtitle: Each location’s muster points: its primary and alternates, how many each holds and how people leave from it.
muster.search: Search by code, name or location
muster.unavailableBody: It is out of use at once. Bringing it back needs a second person’s approval.
muster.reasonRequired: Say why, in at least 3 characters

lifeboats.title: Lifeboats
lifeboats.subtitle: Each craft, where it serves and its certificate. Capacity counts craft in service, less the largest while that rule is on.
lifeboats.search: Search by code, name or location

kpi.heldBack: {{seats}} seats held back (largest craft per location)

lifeboats.takeOutBody: It stops counting at once. Returning it to service needs a second person’s approval.

essential.title: Essential Positions
essential.subtitle: Whether each designation is essential at each site. Changes apply from today or later; past classifications are kept.
essential.timelineHint: Every classification it has had, newest first.
essential.unmappedHint: Designations classified at other sites, or held by people, with no classification here. People holding them here show as “Unmapped — flagged for review”.
essential.allMapped: Every known designation is classified here.

form.notBackdated: Choose today or a later day
form.sitesHint: One change per site, each approved on its own.
form.forwardOnly: Changes apply forward only: the classification in force until then stays on record.

changes.title: Pending Changes
changes.subtitle: Changes to muster points, lifeboats and essential positions: those waiting for a second person, and those decided.
changes.waiting: Waiting for a second person who holds the approval right at this location.
changes.approved: Approved. The change applies in a moment.
changes.returned: Returned to its maker. Nothing changes.

home.loadFailed: Your home page could not be loaded. Try again.

expiring.title: Access expiring
expiring.subline: Within 30 days · Users with no role: {{withoutRoles}}

search.hint: Type at least two characters: a name, personnel no., HSE Passport no., location, installation, or flight or voyage no.
search.failed: The search could not run. Try again.

recurring.title: Recurring Schedules
recurring.subtitle: Routes flown or sailed on a weekly pattern. Saving one plans its journeys up to 180 days ahead.
recurring.search: Search by number, reference, name or route
recurring.reassignmentHint: These journeys have bookings, so they stay as they were when the schedule changed. Move their passengers, then cancel or keep them.
recurring.endBody: Its future journeys without bookings leave the plan; any with bookings stay, to be reassigned. You can resume it later.
recurring.resumeBody: Its journeys are planned again from today.

form.name: Name (optional)
form.timesHint: Times are GST. Without a departure time, journeys wait for one on the Planning Board.
form.numberInvalid: The operator code and three digits, e.g. ADA101
form.validToBefore: Valid to is before valid from
form.arrivalNeedsDeparture: Give the departure time with the arrival time
form.previewNone: No movements from today within the 180-day horizon.
form.previewTaken: Already running on {{count}} of these days: {{dates}}.
form.replanHint: Saving replans its journeys from today: those without bookings follow the change; booked ones are listed for reassignment.

dashboard.title: Scheduling Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Author routes and voyages, and browse what's published — Booking consumes whatever's here

kpi.nextWeek: Nothing planned in the next 7 days
kpi.compatibilityHint: Rotary wing, next 14 days: helideck and aircraft checks (flags only until Phase 7)
kpi.needingRouteHint: From today: no master route goes there

dashboard.conflicts: Fleet conflicts in the next 14 days

board.title: Planning Board
board.subtitle: Planned journeys by month or week, with the weather. Give a departure time to those planned without one.

legend.attention: No time yet, or weather caution

board.untimedHint: Journeys from today whose schedule gives no departure time. Booking shows them without a time until one is given.
board.untimedNone: Every journey from today has a departure time.
board.timedBySchedule: {{ref}} sets this journey’s time: change it on
board.timeHint: Times are GST. An arrival earlier than the departure is the next day. A later change to the schedule keeps this time until the schedule has one of its own.
board.departureRequired: Give the departure time as HH:mm.

weather.advice: NCM advisory: advice only, and operations decide.
weather.unavailable: NCM weather is unavailable just now: no advisories are shown. Nothing is blocked by it.

requests.title: Unscheduled Requests
requests.subtitle: Requests for a route or a day with no movement. Set up a schedule, or create an ad hoc movement for them.
requests.needsRoute: A master route is needed first (Administration · Routes).
requests.empty: No unscheduled requests from this day.
requests.chooseHint: Choose requests to carry them together on one ad hoc movement.

adhoc.title: Ad Hoc Movements
adhoc.subtitle: One-off flights and voyages in the 9xx band, on master routes, for emergencies and accumulated requests.
adhoc.search: Search by number, reference, purpose or route
adhoc.numberInvalid: The operator code and a 9xx number, e.g. ADA901
adhoc.hint: Times are GST. Saving plans its journey at once; the requests chosen travel on it.
adhoc.hasPassengers: It has passengers: its number, route, mode and day stay; its resource, times and purpose can change.
adhoc.suggesting: Looking for master routes that carry them…
adhoc.unplaced: {{count}} of the requests have no master route that carries them, or are no longer open.
adhoc.endBody: Its journey leaves the plan. A movement with passengers can’t be ended until they are moved.

premanifest.title: Pre-manifest
premanifest.subtitle: Who gets a seat on each journey, in order: crew changes, then VIPs, then categories by priority, first come first served. Review, adjust and publish.
premanifest.choose: Choose a journey to review its pre-manifest.
premanifest.notYet: Not suggested yet: it is made {{at}}, or now with Suggest now.
premanifest.nonTimed: No fixed time: {{needing}} need service on this route today; {{here}} are on this run.
premanifest.empty: No approved or waitlisted bookings on this journey.

refresh.title: Refresh the suggestion?
refresh.body: A new suggestion replaces the draft and the changes made to it. The reserve seats stay.

publish.title: Publish the pre-manifest?
publish.body: It becomes final: manifest confirmation starts from it, and it can no longer be refreshed or changed.

exclude.title: Exclude {{name}}?
exclude.body: They stay booked but are left off this pre-manifest. The reason goes to the audit log.

login.title: Log in to AD-MSR Demo
login.invalid: The username or password is incorrect.
login.note: Demo access only. This login is not connected to MASAR or ADNOC accounts, and all data is sample data.
